name: 49696 · Traverse City, MI
findings: ZIP 49696 (Traverse City) has 23 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 7 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49696 (Traverse City) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
100% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
